notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pegasus dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
